output.passCriterion: Verification cases and expected outputs map to parent acceptance criteria and actual product qualification method; no mirror-only demonstration substitutes for the declared user/operating requirement. Planning stage: require a bounded testable plan, sourced priority/dependency rationale and honestly attributed size uncertainty where relevant. Unagreed targets/owners/estimates may remain explicitly pending only before a dependent commitment, approval or ready decision; record the exact unresolved decision and evidence needed. Future execution/launch results remain planned, never fabricated.
output.evidenceRequirement: Current Implementation or verification task revision; explicit applicable field components and pinned authoritative sources. Exact evidence locators and stage-specific decision/evaluation/observation records; no invented facts or substituted future results.

output.repairPrompt: Repair verified gaps, ask only for unavailable necessary facts/authority, bind new evidence to the actual revision and recheck this gate.
